stem.text: Some resistors and a battery of electromotive force (e.m.f.) $E$ and negligible internal resistance are connected in series, as shown.

stem.alt: Series circuit with a battery labelled E and four resistors.

A.text: The e.m.f. across each resistor equals the potential difference across the battery.

B.text: The potential difference across each resistor equals the e.m.f. $E$ of the battery.

C.text: The sum of the e.m.f.s across the resistors equals the potential difference across the battery.

D.text: The sum of the potential differences across the resistors equals the e.m.f. $E$ of the battery.
